scores.thoughts: This bill directly addresses gun control by repealing the Tiahrt Amendments, which currently limit the ATF's ability to collect and use gun-related data, conduct dealer audits, and retain background check records. The stated purpose is to enable more effective policies to prevent illegal gun trafficking, which aligns with stricter gun rules.

The bill aims to strengthen law enforcement's ability to trace firearms and prevent illegal gun trafficking by removing restrictions on data collection and retention. This supports stricter enforcement and policing efforts related to gun crimes.
